domains.name: Developing Code for Data Processing using Python and SQL

exam_rules: Closed-book. No notes or Databricks workspace access. Proctor monitors via webcam.
id_requirements: Government-issued photo ID with full name. Name must match Webassessor registration exactly.

lifecycle.summary: Databricks' exam page is live with a current outline: 'Individuals who pass this certification exam can be expected to complete advanced data engineering tasks using Databricks and its associated tools. The exam covers: Developing Code for Data Processing using Python and SQL - 22% ...', plus live registration ('To register for a certification exam, please log in or create an account on our exam delivery platform') and a two-year recertification rule. Databricks' certification index links it as one of the current exams.

prerequisites.description: Databricks Certified Data Engineer Associate recommended

recommended_experience: hands-on experience performing the data engineering tasks outlined in the exam guide.
renewal_options: Certifications valid for 2 years. Renew by retaking the current version of the exam.

retake_policy.notes: 14-day waiting period after failed attempt. Full exam fee required for retake.
